memory_fact: Planted orange marigold saplings in clay pots on the veranda with grandson Rohan.
Prepared homemade Mirchi ka Salan for Sunday lunch using roasted peanuts and sesame seeds.
Left knee felt slightly stiff after the morning walk; applied warm sesame oil and rested.
Spoke on the phone with childhood friend Saroja from Secunderabad and listened to old radio ghazals.
Dr. Rao advised taking Vitamin D3 after breakfast and drinking 6 glasses of warm water daily.
Watered the marigold pots; noticed the first yellow bud opening and slept early at 9:30 PM.
